newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni to announce Albacom deal Thurs 0900 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Eni to announce Albacom deal Thurs 0900 GMT.

text.p: Italian energy company Eni said it would hold a news conference at 0900 GMT on Thursday to announce a deal with the mobile telephone venture Albacom owned jointly by British Telecommunications Plc, Italian banking group BNL and communications venture Mediaset.
Eni said in a statement it was holding the news conference "to announce the deal with Albacom".
Sources close to the negotiations said on Tuesday Eni was poised to take a stake of aroudn 35 percent in Albacom Spa.
BT and BNL at present hold a 70 percent stake in Albacom Spa through Albacom Finanziaria, an investment vehicle which they jointly own. Mediaset owns a direct 30 percent stake in Albacom Spa.
Albacom has said it intends to bid for a licence to become Italy's third mobile phone operator.
